english: I've had a lot of complaints about campers camping here.'
text: I've had a lot of complaints 强调他已收到不少投诉，为眼下的干预提供依据。这里 have 是“收到、经历”，不是拥有投诉这件物品；谈反馈或麻烦，也可用 have complaints、have problems。
